job.title: Senior Privacy Specialist
job.description:
PQE Partners are working with a highly regarded, complex organisation to appoint a Senior Privacy Specialist into its established legal team.

This is a newly created position and the organisation’s first dedicated privacy hire, offering the successful person genuine ownership of the privacy function and the opportunity to shape how privacy is managed across the business.

There is an existing privacy framework in place; however, with an increasing organisational focus on privacy and significant regulatory change underway in Australia, the business is looking to appoint an experienced privacy professional to take ownership of the area, identify gaps and continue to uplift and embed its approach.

Reporting to a senior member of the legal leadership team, you will become the key privacy SME across the organisation. You will work closely with stakeholders across Legal, Risk, Compliance, Technology, Cyber Security and Data/AI Governance, providing practical advice and ensuring privacy considerations are effectively understood and managed.

Stakeholder engagement will be a significant part of the position. You will work with employees and senior leadership to increase privacy awareness across the organisation, develop and deliver training and translate complex legislative and regulatory requirements into clear, practical advice. There will also be the opportunity to engage at executive level and contribute to Board-level reporting.

Key responsibilities will include:
• Taking ownership of and continuing to develop the organisation’s privacy management framework
• Advising on compliance with the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth), Australian Privacy Principles and other relevant requirements
• Advising on Privacy Impact Assessments for new projects, systems and initiatives
• Identifying privacy risks and developing practical mitigation strategies
• Managing and advising on privacy incidents and data breaches, including obligations under the Notifiable Data Breaches regime
• Maintaining and enhancing privacy policies, processes, notices and governance
• Monitoring developments in the Australian privacy regulatory landscape and advising the business on their impact
• Developing and delivering privacy training and awareness initiatives
• Working collaboratively across Legal, Risk, Technology, Cyber Security and Data/AI Governance
• Providing ad hoc support on Freedom of Information matters where required
About you You will have a legal degree (LLB or JD) together with strong, dedicated privacy experience and the technical capability to operate as the organisation’s key privacy specialist.

You will ideally bring:
• Significant experience working in privacy, ideally within financial services, professional services or another complex and highly regulated environment
• Strong knowledge of the Privacy Act and Australian Privacy Principles
• Experience developing, implementing or uplifting privacy frameworks and processes
• Practical experience with PIAs, privacy risk and data breach/incident management
• Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing skills
• The ability to communicate technical privacy requirements clearly to non-specialists
• Confidence presenting and engaging with senior stakeholders and leadership teams
• A practical, commercial and solutions-focused approach

This is a particularly interesting opportunity for an experienced privacy professional looking to step into a visible, standalone role with the mandate to shape and develop an organisation’s privacy capability.

The organisation operates in a sophisticated and highly regulated environment, with exposure across finance, major projects and complex transactions. You will also be joining a high-calibre and established legal team with a strong culture and excellent retention.

job.title: Head of Legal
job.description:
PQE Partners are exclusively representing a high-growth financial services business in their search for a Head of Legal. This is a hands-on leadership role that will see you lead the legal function and manage a small team, while working closely with senior stakeholders across the organisation.
  
The business has experienced significant growth over the past few years, bringing greater scale, regulatory complexity and an evolving product offering. This is an opportunity to join at an interesting point in its journey, with plenty of complex and meaningful work ahead.
  
As Head of Legal, you will:
  • Develop and implement legal strategies aligned with business goals and continued growth.
  • Ensure compliance with Australian regulatory requirements, including the Corporations Act, ASIC regulations and the National Consumer Credit Protection Act.
  • Support treasury transactions, funding arrangements and securitisation matters, including coordination with external counsel.
  • Oversee the drafting, review and negotiation of loan agreements, vendor agreements and other commercial contracts.
  • Provide advice on legal and regulatory risk, corporate governance and internal policies.
  • Manage disputes and external dispute resolution processes, engaging external counsel where required.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders across the business, providing pragmatic advice and constructively challenging where required.
  • Lead, develop and support two direct reports within the legal team.
  
About You:
  • A minimum of 8 years PQE gained in private practice or in-house, with solid financial services regulatory experience.
  • Strong knowledge of lending, NCCP, consumer credit and AML/CTF.
  • A strong understanding of Australian regulatory frameworks, ideally gained within lending or a related financial services environment.
  • Commercially minded and capable of balancing legal and regulatory risk with the commercial objectives of the business.
  • A confident and engaging stakeholder manager who is comfortable navigating differing views, challenging where necessary and establishing credibility with senior stakeholders.
  • Proactive, resilient and solutions-focused, with a genuine ‘can-do’ approach.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where you will be expected to take ownership, make decisions and continue developing the legal function.
  
What’s on Offer:
  • A senior leadership appointment with significant visibility and influence across the business.
  • Management of two direct reports, providing a balance between team leadership and remaining close to the legal work.
  • The opportunity to join a business that has experienced significant growth, with new products, increasing regulatory complexity and plenty of interesting work ahead.
  • A role that will stretch and develop you, providing highly sought-after experience across legal leadership, financial services regulation, funding and broader commercial matters.
  • The opportunity to build on a legal function that has established strong credibility within the business and continue shaping its role as the organisation evolves.
  • Full-time, permanent role based in Sydney (hybrid).
  
If you’re an experienced financial services lawyer looking to take ownership of a legal function, lead a capable team and work within a growing and evolving business, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Legal Counsel - Funds
job.description:
PQE Partners are working with a leading financial services organisation looking to hire a funds and investments lawyer to its Sydney legal team.

The role sits within an established legal function and will be the key legal position dedicated to supporting the organisation’s significant and active investment portfolio.

The team is ideally looking for someone around 3–7 PQE, although there is flexibility to consider a more senior lawyer, particularly someone seeking a four-day working week.

Reporting to the Head of Legal and working closely with the executive responsible for investments and their senior team, you will:
  • Advise on a broad range of funds and investment management matters.
  • Draft, negotiate and advise on investment management agreements and other investment-related documentation.
  • Support investment transactions and associated regulatory matters.
  • Advise on and manage FIRB applications.
  • Manage investment-related disputes and smaller litigation matters, including working with external counsel where appropriate.
  • Provide commercial and pragmatic advice directly to senior investment stakeholders.
  • Support the broader legal team across related financial services matters as required.
You will be a qualified lawyer with experience in funds and/or investment management gained within a fund, financial institution or leading law firm.

Ideally, you will bring:
  • Approximately 3–7+ years’ PQE in funds or investment management.
  • Experience advising on investment management arrangements and transactions.
  • Exposure to superannuation, life insurance or broader financial services would be advantageous.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the confidence to work directly with senior stakeholders.
  • The ability to work autonomously and take ownership of an investment-focused legal remit.
  • Strong drafting, communication and relationship management skills.
You do not need experience across every aspect of the role. Of greater importance is a strong grounding in funds and investment management and the ability to operate commercially within a sophisticated investment environment.
The role offers an unusual level of ownership. You will be the dedicated lawyer supporting the investments function, working directly with an experienced and close-knit investment leadership team, while still having the support of a broader legal team.

The scale and activity of the organisation’s investment portfolio also makes this a particularly interesting opportunity for someone who wants exposure comparable to a large institutional investor or superannuation fund, rather than a narrower financial services legal role.

There is flexibility around seniority and the team is open to considering an experienced lawyer seeking a four-day working week, subject to remuneration.

Please contact Katie Mitchell at PQE Partners for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Legal Counsel, Institutional
job.description:
PQE Partners are working with a highly regarded institutional organisation looking to appoint an experienced banking and finance lawyer to its Sydney legal team.

The role sits within a sophisticated legal function supporting complex, high-value financing and investment transactions, with significant exposure to cross-border matters, major infrastructure and project financing.

This is an initial 6-month fixed-term contract, with the potential for the role to transition to permanent.

Working closely with senior lawyers and stakeholders across the organisation, you will:
  • Advise on corporate, project and infrastructure financing transactions.
  • Draft, negotiate and advise on loans, guarantees, bonds and other financing documentation.
  • Support complex cross-border transactions and investments.
  • Advise on the legal aspects of transactions from structuring and negotiation through to execution and ongoing management.
  • Work closely with senior internal stakeholders, counterparties and leading external law firms.
  • Support new products, structured transactions and risk transfer arrangements.
  • Provide pragmatic and commercially focused legal advice across a broad institutional finance remit.
You will be a qualified lawyer with a strong banking and finance background gained within a leading or mid-tier law firm, financial institution or other sophisticated in-house environment.

Ideally, you will bring:
  • Approximately 5–8+ years’ PQE in banking and finance.
  • Experience across corporate, project, infrastructure, asset or acquisition finance.
  • Project and infrastructure finance experience would be particularly relevant.
  • Strong transactional and drafting skills.
  • Experience working on complex or cross-border transactions would be advantageous.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the confidence to work directly with senior stakeholders.
  • The ability to manage transactions autonomously while working collaboratively within an experienced legal team.
The breadth and scale of the organisation’s mandate makes this a particularly interesting opportunity for a banking and finance lawyer looking for exposure beyond a traditional financing role. The work spans significant domestic and international transactions, with exposure to infrastructure, investment and strategically important projects.

The opportunity could suit a private practice lawyer looking to make their first move in-house, or an experienced in-house lawyer seeking a broader and more complex transactional remit.

PQE Partners know the organisation and legal team well, having placed a number of lawyers with the business, and have received consistently positive feedback from those who have joined.

The role is based in Sydney with a flexible hybrid working model.

Please contact Katie Mitchell at PQE Partners for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Senior Associate - Commercial Litigation & Insolvency
job.description:
Associate / Senior Associate – Commercial Litigation & Insolvency
PQE Partners are exclusively representing a growing boutique law firm that continues to build strong momentum in the market. Having partnered with the firm on multiple successful hires, including at Senior Associate level, we have seen first-hand the quality of work, leadership and trajectory of the practice.
  
Following continued growth and an increasing pipeline of complex matters, the firm is now seeking to add another high-calibre litigator to its team. This is a genuine opportunity to join a practice that is scaling in a considered way, with strong foundations already in place.
  
Key Responsibilities
As Associate / Senior Associate, you will work closely with the firm’s founders and play a key role in advising clients across a broad range of disputes, including but not limited to:
  • Complex commercial litigation matters, including debt recovery disputes
  • Insolvency and restructuring litigation, acting for a range of stakeholders
  • High-stakes disputes for corporate clients, SMEs, and individuals
  • Supervising and mentoring junior lawyers, helping to shape the next generation of the firm’s talent
  • Developing client relationships and originating new matters, with support from the partners
  
About You
The ideal candidate will be a Senior Associate or a strong Associate ready to step up, with:
  • 4+ years’ post-admission experience in commercial litigation and/or insolvency
  • The ability to run matters with increasing autonomy
  • A commercial mindset and confidence dealing directly with clients
  • Strong advocacy and drafting skills
  • An interest in being part of a growing boutique and contributing beyond pure fee-earning
  
What’s on Offer
This is a genuinely different opportunity to the traditional law firm pathway, offering:
  • A clear trajectory as the firm continues to grow, with future equity potential
  • Commission incentives on work you originate
  • Direct exposure to founders and clients from day one
  • A high-trust environment with real autonomy
  • The opportunity to join a team where recent hires have integrated quickly and are already making a tangible impact
  
If you are a commercial litigator with insolvency experience and are looking to take the next step in a growing and well-positioned firm, please contact Katie Mitchell at PQE Partners for a confidential discussion or apply directly.

job.title: Associate / Senior Associate
job.description:
PQE Partners are representing a highly regarded national commercial and property law firm with a strong reputation across strata and community titles, property development and complex disputes.
  
As the firm continues to grow its Melbourne practice, they are looking to appoint an Associate or Senior Associate to work closely with an accomplished Partner and a broader team of leading practitioners in this space.
  
The Partner is hands-on, supportive and committed to developing the lawyers within their team. For someone looking to deepen their property litigation experience, the role offers a strong combination of quality work, direct Partner exposure and genuine mentorship.
  
You will work across a varied mix of property-related disputes, litigation and advisory matters, including:
  
  • Property development, strata, insurance and broader property matters
  • Commercial and contractual disputes
  • Construction disputes and building defect claims
  • Strata and community title disputes, with a particular focus on Victorian legislation
  • Collective sales and scheme terminations
  • Drafting court documents, legal correspondence and client advice
  • Managing matters and attending court hearings
  • Briefing counsel and preparing witness and expert evidence
  • Preparing matters for interlocutory and final hearings
  
The firm is open to a Senior Associate or a strong Associate looking to take the next step in their career. You will ideally have:
  
  • 4+ years' PQE
  • Experience in property law and/or property-related disputes
  • Commercial or property litigation experience
  • Strata and community titles experience would be highly regarded
  • Exposure to VCAT, Supreme Court and/or Federal Court proceedings
  • Strong drafting and client management skills
  • A collaborative approach and an interest in continuing to develop your technical expertise
  
You will join a well-established national firm while being part of a growing Melbourne practice, giving you the benefit of an established platform alongside the opportunity to have a meaningful role in the development of the local team.
  
The firm offers:
  
  • Direct access to and mentoring from highly experienced practitioners
  • A broad mix of quality property litigation and advisory work
  • Realistic billing expectations and a staff incentive programme
  • Competitive remuneration based on experience
  • Flexible working and a genuine focus on work-life balance
  • Clear opportunities for progression as the Melbourne practice continues to grow
  
For a confidential discussion, please contact PQE Partners.

job.title: Associate - Litigation | Sydney
job.description:
About the Opportunity
  
PQE Partners are representing a highly regarded national commercial and property law firm, known for their deep expertise across strata and community titles, property development and litigation. As the firm continues its expansion, an opportunity has arisen for an Associate to join the Sydney team.
  
This is a unique chance to work directly under highly accomplished and esteemed partner with over 20 years of experience in this area. You’ll work closely with him, and alongside some of Australia’s top practitioners in this space – on a high-quality mix of litigation, advisory and commercial property matters.
  
Having placed several lawyers with this firm nationally, we can genuinely vouch for the culture and quality of the team. They are a collegiate, down-to-earth group who take pride in producing excellent work, support each other properly and are serious about long-term career development. Expectations are high, but realistic, and work life balance is genuinely respected rather than simply talked about.
  
Key Responsibilities

You will support across a diverse range of property-related disputes and advisory matters, including:
  • Strata and community title disputes
  • Property development, insurance, leasing and general property law
  • Construction disputes and broader contractual issues
  • Debt recovery and enforcement
  • Drafting legal correspondence, court documents and client advice
  • Attending court hearings and preparing materials for both interlocutory and final hearings
  • Briefing counsel and assisting with witness and expert evidence
  • Managing your own files with growing responsibility
  
About You
You will have at 3-5 years PQE. Strata/property experience would be highly regarded but it is not essential. If you have relatable litigation experience, are keen to learn and would be interested in this growing area of law, then please get in touch.
  
You need to be ambitious and a proactive self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.
  
What’s on Offer

This is a standout opportunity to develop your legal career under the guidance of an exceptional leader and within a firm that is highly respected in this space. You’ll gain exposure to a wide variety of matters, enjoy structured mentorship and support and be part of an expanding office where your contribution will be valued. This firm offers industry leading billable targets that are very achievable because they understand the how important it is for employees to balance work and life!
  
Please reach out for a confidential chat if you'd like to hear more about the firm/work and see if it could be a good fit.
